environment.description: Kubernetes cluster running Celery workers in the 'data-pipeline' namespace. The ingestion-gateway service in the 'api-gateway' namespace accepts archive uploads via HTTP POST and publishes Celery tasks to Redis. No service mesh is deployed. The worker pod runs as root with hostPath volume mount at /var/lib/worker. Any service in the cluster can connect to the Redis broker at redis.data-pipeline.svc.cluster.local:6379 and submit tasks directly.
